The original file stays immutable; this erratum is the audit authority for the six paths.

future_declaration_rule: A declaration must not copy descriptive text from an earlier campaign and treat byte-equality with that campaign as proof of correctness. The audit freezes explicit policy values, and every descriptive string leaf (20+ characters, not a bare identifier/hash/timestamp) byte-identical to the Batch 01 corrected declaration must be individually reviewed and listed, otherwise it is a defect (batch02_erratum.unreviewed_copied_descriptions).
